sourceRevision.note: The page digest covers current on-disk App, page, component, page-access and admin-access-policy sources; the generation-evidence digest covers the UI and server source files cited in the MaxCore button inventory. Both include uncommitted edits.

gate.reason: All required checks need exact current passing-case links, resolved mappings and actual execution coverage; static source matches do not close feature acceptance.

methodology.confidence: Static source inventory only. Purpose statements use visible headings/labels when found; otherwise they are explicitly name-inferred. Handler names, hook names and URL literals are source links, not verified outcomes.
limitations: A route declaration, import graph, JSX node or API URL does not prove that a component mounts, an action succeeds, or a server authorizes a request.
Conditional branches, state-dependent mounts, feature flags, responsive visibility and data-driven lists are recorded as static signals; exact runtime expansion is not known.

Source file/module summaries can include code from multiple exports; canonical IDs preserve the imported export name, while module-level behavior is explicitly source evidence rather than a runtime trace.
External UI primitives without client source are listed as package-provided; their internal behavior is not attributed to this repository.
API literals are candidate client connections only. The platform register's frontend contract/backend matching remains authoritative for its own documented limitations.
No browser, end-to-end, authorization, persistence, provider or product-behavior verification was run for this documentation task.

globalBlock.behavior: shouldBlockNonAdminApp may replace the application with an administrator-only gate; the rendered gate offers sign-out and shows policy verification or public-access-closed status.

authRedirect.behavior: After auth loading, signed-out visitors are redirected unless isPublicPageRoute accepts the current path.

nativeLandingRedirect.behavior: Authenticated native clients can be redirected from marketing/auth pages to /dashboard.

globalApplication.globalComponentConditions: AIAssistantManager selects public or personalized assistant by user presence; NPSSurveyManager mounts only when its hook reports visible; shortcut dialog mounts under its open state; remaining components are mounted under a lazy Suspense/ErrorBoundary shell, with component-specific conditions in their source.
